movie:157336.src: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movie:157336.text: A group of explorers use a newly found shortcut through space to go farther than any human has travelled before.

movie:27205.src: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
movie:27205.text: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets from inside people's minds is offered his old life back for a job everyone calls impossible: planting an idea instead of taking one.

movie:24428.src: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D.
movie:24428.text: When an unexpected enemy threatens the safety of the whole world, the head of an international peacekeeping agency has to act.

movie:155.src: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets.
movie:155.text: A masked vigilante raises the stakes in his war on crime, teaming up with a police lieutenant and the district attorney to take apart the gangs still running the streets.

movie:19995.src: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.
movie:19995.text: Far in the future, a Marine who can no longer walk is sent to a distant moon on a one-of-a-kind mission, and ends up torn between his orders and protecting the people who live there.

movie:550.src: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy.
movie:550.text: A disturbed man and a slippery salesman channel raw male aggression into a shocking new kind of therapy.

movie:293660.src: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool.
movie:293660.text: A special forces soldier turned gun-for-hire goes through a rogue experiment that leaves him able to heal from almost anything, and takes on a whole new identity.

movie:299536.src: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos.
movie:299536.text: A team of heroes who protect the world from threats too big for any one of them faces a new danger rising out of deep space.

movie:278.src: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden.
movie:278.text: Sent to prison for a double murder, an upstanding professional starts life over behind bars and puts his head for numbers to work for the man who runs the place.

movie:680.src: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper.
movie:680.text: A hit man and his philosophical partner, a gangster's drug-addled girlfriend and a washed-up boxer cross paths in a sprawling, darkly funny crime story.

movie:13.src: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do.
movie:13.text: A simple man achieves great things and keeps turning up at big moments in history, each time going far beyond what anyone imagined he could do.

movie:118340.src: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.
movie:118340.text: Far from Earth, years after he was taken from it, a man becomes the target of a manhunt when he finds an object a ruthless villain badly wants.

movie:671.src: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life.
movie:671.text: A boy has spent his whole life living under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house.

movie:603.src: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
movie:603.text: Far in the future, a computer hacker joins a band of underground rebels fighting the powerful machines that now rule the earth.

movie:1726.src: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.
movie:1726.text: After being held captive in a cave, a billionaire engineer builds a one-of-a-kind armoured suit and uses it to fight back.

movie:68718.src: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
movie:68718.text: With help from an unlikely partner who hunts men for money, a freed man sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

movie:299534.src: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos.
movie:299534.text: After devastating events, the universe lies in ruins, wrecked by one all-powerful villain.

movie:475557.src: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.
movie:475557.text: A failed entertainer is pushed past breaking point and turns to crime and chaos, becoming an infamous name in his city.

tv:1399.src: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north.
tv:1399.text: Seven noble families fight for control of a mythical land until their feuding becomes all-out war, while an ancient evil stirs in the far north.

movie:120.src: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator.
movie:120.text: A young villager inherits a mysterious heirloom from his uncle and has to leave home to keep it out of the hands of the evil power that made it.

movie:597.src: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé.
movie:597.text: A very old woman finally tells the story of a sea voyage from long ago, which she set out on as a young woman with her mother and her fiancé.

movie:122.src: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men.
movie:122.text: As armies gather for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world, one of a small band of travellers is revealed as the rightful heir to an ancient throne.

movie:106646.src: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.
movie:106646.text: A stockbroker refuses to cooperate with a massive fraud case that reaches from the banks to the mob. Based on the real man's own memoir.

movie:11324.src: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
movie:11324.text: A soldier turned federal marshal investigates a patient's disappearance from a hospital for the criminally insane, but troubling visions and a mysterious doctor get in his way.

movie:99861.src: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance.
movie:99861.text: When one hero tries to restart a dormant peacekeeping programme, it goes badly wrong, and a team of heroes faces its toughest test with the whole planet at stake.

movie:49026.src: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department.
movie:49026.text: After the death of the city's district attorney, a masked vigilante takes the blame for the dead man's crimes to protect his good name, and the police start hunting him.

movie:16869.src: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis.
movie:16869.text: In occupied France during the Second World War, a band of Jewish-American soldiers is picked to spread terror among the Nazis through brutal killings.

movie:76341.src: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life.
movie:76341.text: In a broken world at the far edge of a scorched desert, nearly everyone has gone mad fighting over what's left to survive on.

movie:271110.src: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity.
movie:271110.text: The world's governments pass a law to control everyone with superhuman powers.

movie:121.src: Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths.
movie:121.text: A small band of companions carries on with its sacred quest to destroy a powerful heirloom, but now on separate paths.

movie:807.src: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next.
movie:807.text: Two homicide detectives desperately hunt a killer whose crimes follow an ancient list of sins, from one tortured victim to the next.

movie:672.src: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts.
movie:672.text: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a strange little servant creature turns up to warn a boy at the start of his second year at school.

movie:284054.src: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader.
movie:284054.text: A new king returns to his hidden, technologically advanced African nation to take up the throne.

movie:150540.src: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition.
movie:150540.text: When a girl moves to a new city, the feelings that run her mind team up to help her through the change.

movie:284052.src: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
movie:284052.text: After his career is wrecked, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a second chance when a mysterious teacher takes him in and trains him to protect the world from evil.

movie:68721.src: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.
movie:68721.text: When a fearsome terrorist tears his world apart, a hero sets out to rebuild himself and get even.

movie:238.src: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family.
movie:238.text: Over ten years after the war, the story of an Italian-American crime family.

movie:70160.src: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.
movie:70160.text: In a cruel future society where every region must send two young people to fight to the death on live TV, a girl volunteers to take her sister's place.

movie:315635.src: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.
movie:315635.text: A teenager tries to balance ordinary high school life in New York with secretly fighting crime, guided by an older mentor, as a new threat appears.

movie:673.src: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.
movie:673.text: A boy's life is in danger again when a dangerous man escapes from prison and heads for his school.

movie:283995.src: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
movie:283995.text: A ragtag team fights to keep its newfound family together while uncovering the truth about who their leader's father really is.

movie:1771.src: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort.
movie:1771.text: During the Second World War, a frail young man is transformed into something more than human to help win the war.

movie:272.src: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.
movie:272.text: Driven by tragedy, a billionaire devotes his life to rooting out the corruption eating away at his home city.

movie:10138.src: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military.
movie:10138.text: Now that the world knows his secret double life as an armoured hero, a billionaire inventor is pressured by the government, the press and the public to hand his technology to the military.

movie:11.src: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire.
movie:11.text: A princess is captured and held hostage by the forces of a tyrannical regime tightening its grip on the galaxy.

movie:10195.src: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment.
movie:10195.text: Defying his father, a powerful but arrogant prince of the gods recklessly restarts an ancient war, and is cast down to Earth to live among humans as punishment.

movie:22.src: When wily pirate Captain Barbossa seizes Jack Sparrow’s beloved ship, the Black Pearl, and kidnaps the governor’s daughter, Elizabeth Swann, blacksmith Will Turner reluctantly teams up with the unpredictable pirate Jack to rescue her—only to uncover a terrifying curse that turns Barbossa’s crew into the undead.
movie:22.text: When a rival captain steals a pirate's beloved ship and kidnaps the governor's daughter, a young blacksmith reluctantly teams up with the unpredictable pirate to rescue her, and finds a dark spell that turns the rival's crew into the undead.

movie:674.src: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools.
movie:674.text: When his name is drawn, a teenage boy is entered into a gruelling contest for glory between three schools.

movie:634649.src: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero.
movie:634649.text: A young hero's secret identity is exposed, and he can no longer keep his normal life apart from the danger of his other one.

movie:297761.src: From DC Comics comes the Suicide Squad, an antihero team of incarcerated supervillains who act as deniable assets for the United States government, undertaking high-risk black ops missions in exchange for commuted prison sentences.
movie:297761.text: A team of jailed supervillains carries out deniable, high-risk secret missions for the government in exchange for shorter sentences.

movie:284053.src: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
movie:284053.text: Imprisoned on the far side of the universe, a warrior prince races to get home before a ruthless new enemy destroys his world and everyone on it.

movie:12445.src: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all.
movie:12445.text: Three young friends press on with their quest to defeat an evil lord once and for all.

movie:105.src: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest.
movie:105.text: A teenager is accidentally sent back thirty years, gets in the way of his parents' first meeting, and catches the eye of his own mother instead.

movie:14160.src: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest.
movie:14160.text: A man has spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the world and living it to the full.

movie:135397.src: Twenty-two years after the events of Jurassic Park, Isla Nublar now features a fully functioning dinosaur theme park, Jurassic World, as originally envisioned by John Hammond.
movie:135397.text: Decades after the first attempt, the island now has a fully working attraction full of living prehistoric creatures, just as its founder once dreamed.

tv:66732.src: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.
tv:66732.text: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying forces and one strange little girl.

movie:286217.src: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet.
movie:286217.text: Presumed dead after a fierce storm, an astronaut is left behind by his crew, but he has survived, and is now stranded alone on a hostile planet.

movie:354912.src: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz.
movie:354912.text: Despite his family's strange, generations-old ban on music, a boy dreams of becoming a great musician like his idol.

movie:98.src: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred.
movie:98.text: When the old emperor dies, his devious son takes power and strips the rank of the general his father favoured.

movie:297762.src: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.
movie:297762.text: A warrior princess comes into the world of men in the middle of the First World War to face the forces of evil and end the fighting.

movie:245891.src: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.
movie:245891.text: A retired hit man goes back to work to hunt down the gangsters who took everything from him.

movie:102899.src: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats.
movie:102899.text: Given the power to shrink in size while growing in strength, a master thief has to find the hero in himself and help his mentor protect the secret behind a remarkable suit.

movie:675.src: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.
movie:675.text: When a new teacher's methods leave the school unprepared for the rising evil, one student starts teaching the others how to defend themselves.

movie:767.src: Dumbledore tries to prepare Harry for the final battle with Voldemort while Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds.
movie:767.text: An old wizard tries to prepare a young one for the final battle with a dark lord, while the dark lord's followers wreak havoc in the magical and ordinary worlds alike.

movie:496243.src: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
movie:496243.text: A family with no jobs between them takes a keen interest in a wealthy, glamorous household as a way to make a living, until an unexpected incident drags them all in.

movie:557.src: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.
movie:557.text: After being bitten by a genetically altered creature, a nerdy but likeable high school student gains amazing powers.

movie:12.src: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium.
movie:12.text: An adventurous young fish is snatched from his reef home and ends up in a tank in a dentist's office.

movie:140607.src: Thirty years after defeating the Galactic Empire, Han Solo and his allies face a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren and his army of Stormtroopers.
movie:140607.text: Decades after a tyrannical regime was defeated, an old hero and his allies face a new threat from a dark warrior and his army.

movie:37165.src: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.
movie:37165.text: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman starts to suspect that his whole life is staged and watched by a vast unseen audience.

movie:12444.src: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality.
movie:12444.text: Three friends walk away from their last year of school to hunt down and destroy the hidden objects that keep a dark lord from dying.

movie:263115.src: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border.
movie:263115.text: In the near future, a weary man looks after his ailing mentor in a hideout near the Mexican border.

movie:10681.src: After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E— a robot designed to clean up the earth—discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE.
movie:10681.text: After hundreds of years doing the one job he was built for, a little clean-up robot finds a new purpose when he meets a sleek visitor.

movie:210577.src: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.
movie:210577.text: When his wife's disappearance turns into a media circus, a man finds the spotlight turning on him as people start to wonder if he's really innocent.

movie:346364.src: In a small town in Maine, seven children known as The Losers Club come face to face with life problems, bullies and a monster that takes the shape of a clown called Pennywise.
movie:346364.text: In a small town, seven misfit kids face their own problems, the local bullies, and a monster that takes the shape of a clown.

movie:862.src: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz.
movie:862.text: A boy's longtime favourite fears losing his place when a new arrival turns up on the boy's birthday, and starts plotting against him.

movie:100402.src: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D.
movie:100402.text: After a cataclysmic battle, a man out of his own time lives quietly in Washington and tries to adjust to the modern world.

movie:8587.src: Young lion prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself.
movie:8587.text: A young heir who can't wait to rule grows up under his father's watchful eye, while his uncle quietly plots to take the throne.

movie:585.src: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis.
movie:585.text: A lovable giant and his wisecracking sidekick are the top team at a factory that runs on children's screams.

movie:329865.src: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
movie:329865.text: When mysterious ships land around the world, the military recruits a language expert to find out whether the visitors come in peace.

movie:259316.src: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats.
movie:259316.text: A wizard arrives in America with a magically enlarged briefcase that holds a number of dangerous creatures and their homes.

movie:49051.src: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.
movie:49051.text: A homebody who loves his quiet life is swept into an epic quest by a wandering wizard and a company of dwarves who want their mountain back from a dragon.

tv:71446.src: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose.
tv:71446.text: To pull off the biggest robbery in history, a mysterious mastermind recruits a crew of eight with one thing in common: none of them has anything to lose.

movie:281957.src: In the 1820s, a frontiersman, Hugh Glass, sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear mauling.
movie:281957.text: Two hundred years ago, a frontiersman sets out for revenge on the men who left him for dead after a brutal animal attack.

movie:497.src: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments.
movie:497.text: On death row in a Southern prison, a gentle giant of an inmate turns out to have a mysterious power to heal.

movie:383498.src: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.
movie:383498.text: A wisecracking mercenary takes on a powerful enemy and a few other bad guys to save a boy's life.

movie:209112.src: Fearing the actions of a god-like Super Hero left unchecked, Gotham City’s own formidable, forceful vigilante takes on Metropolis’s most revered, modern-day savior, while the world wrestles with what sort of hero it really needs.
movie:209112.text: Fearing a godlike hero that answers to no one, a ruthless vigilante sets out to take him down, while the world argues over what kind of hero it really needs.

movie:24.src: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.
movie:24.text: Shot by her ruthless boss and the other members of their gang of killers, an assassin survives, and starts planning her revenge.

movie:694.src: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter.
movie:694.text: A man takes a job as caretaker of a remote hotel for the winter, cut off from the rest of the world with his wife and young son.

movie:9806.src: Bob Parr has given up his superhero days to log in time as an insurance adjuster and raise his three children with his formerly heroic wife in suburbia.
movie:9806.text: A former hero has given up hero work for an insurance job and a suburban life with his wife, also a former hero, and their three kids.

movie:419430.src: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend.
movie:419430.text: A young man and his girlfriend head out of the city to spend the weekend with her parents.

movie:808.src: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek.
movie:808.text: Life isn't easy when you're green, likeable and, admittedly, a bit smelly.

movie:1930.src: Peter Parker is an outcast high schooler abandoned by his parents as a boy, leaving him to be raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May.
movie:1930.text: Abandoned by his parents as a little boy, an outcast high schooler is raised by his uncle and aunt.

tv:1396.src: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live.
tv:1396.text: A schoolteacher in the American Southwest is told he has a serious illness and not long to live.

movie:2062.src: Remy, a rat, possesses a palate far more refined than that of his fellow comrades. He dreams of becoming a chef, one who creates rather than scavenges.
movie:2062.text: A small creature with a far more refined palate than the rest of his family dreams of cooking instead of scavenging.

movie:1891.src: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke.
movie:1891.text: The saga continues: a young hero learns the old ways from an aging master, hoping to defeat a tyrannical regime, while its most feared enforcer is more determined than ever to catch him.

movie:77338.src: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.
movie:77338.text: A true story of two men who should never have met: an aristocrat paralysed in an accident, and a young man from the poorest part of town.

movie:101299.src: After surviving the Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta struggle with the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem.
movie:101299.text: After surviving a deadly televised contest, two young winners struggle with what their victory set off as unrest spreads across the country.

movie:129.src: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.
movie:129.text: A young girl is trapped in a strange world of spirits, and when her parents are mysteriously transformed, she has to find courage she never knew she had to free them.

movie:205596.src: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.
